The experiments are built as matched pairs and small sets. Each set applies the same edit to parents that differ mainly in one condition. The conditions fall into four kinds:

- **Topology dead-ends.** Node 1 has no input when edge 0 is none. Node 2 has no input when edges 1 and 2 are none. A node's output is unused when all of its outgoing edges are none.
- **Whether the cell has a residual path.** This is edge 3 set to skip versus none.
- **What op the edit replaces.** These are the k = j conditions.
- **How many convolutions the cell already has.** This covers pool and skip edits in conv-heavy cells versus conv-free cells.
